# AI 文案去味器 · De-AI Writer
> Rewrite AI-sounding Chinese copy into text that reads like a human wrote it.
把 AI 生成的中文改写成**有真人味**的文字：专治空洞拔高、排比三连、官方黑话、模板化结尾。适用于公众号、小红书、电商文案、产品描述。
No build step, no account, no telemetry.
Ask your agent: *"帮我把这段去一下 AI 味"* and it will drive the script for you.
Python 3.9+. **Zero third-party dependencies** (standard library only). `LLM_API_KEY` is optional —
The zero-cost mode exists on purpose: you can evaluate the rewriting logic before spending a single
ro-cost mode exists on purpose: you can evaluate the rewriting logic before spending a single token.

MIT — see LICENSE. Issues and PRs welcome.
Part of the hermes-skills collection.
